function: F-01.1 — Provide autopilot target values (altitude, heading, speed) to the aircraft. The HMI exists to let the pilot supply the numeric flight targets the autopilot needs; measurable effect = a valid, complete parameter set (alt/hdg/spd) delivered to the aircraft.
function_summary: Enter autopilot flight targets (altitude, heading, speed)
behaviour: Be-01.1.2 (Keyboard-only): pilot selects the target field via WAD bezel OSS (stepping through ALT/HDG/SPD), enters the numeric value on the UCP alphanumeric keyboard / rotary encoder with char display + WAD echo, invalid entries rejected with re-entry prompt, confirm via dedicated bezel OSS — full task doable without touching the screen. Be-01.1.3 (Mixed): field-focus and value-entry accepted from Touch and Keyboard interchangeably at any sub-step; Touch cases use an on-screen numeric keypad widget for entry; either modality can select field or enter value, exploiting touch speed for selection and keyboard/rotary precision for numerals. Both behaviours carry modality-agnostic envelope validation as an internal property: every entered value is validated against the autopilot flight envelope regardless of input method, invalid values flagged and blocked, commit only on a valid complete set.
behaviour_summary: Keyboard-only and mixed-modality field entry with envelope validation.
structure: S-01.1.2/3.1 — Autopilot Parameter Panel: WAD overlay layer with ALT / HDG / SPD fields, each showing current value + valid range + live invalid-flag state; on-screen numeric keypad widget invoked on field tap (Touch/TDC entry); WAD bezel with one focus OSS per field, a rotary encoder for value stepping, and a CONFIRM OSS; UCP alphanumeric keyboard with char display echoing the selected field; single downstream validation gate that runs the envelope check and blocks CONFIRM until all three fields are valid. Serves both Be-01.1.2 and Be-01.1.3.
structure_summary: Multi-Input Autopilot Parameter Entry Panel with Validation Gate
